newsitem.title: USA: Corning Inc Q3 oper net higher.
newsitem.headline: Corning Inc Q3 oper net higher.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE - 1995 figures adjusted to account for change in fiscal quarter from 16-week period to 12-week period, and to account for spin-off of health care services unit as a discontinued operation.
Figures exclude discontinued operations loss $115.0 million vs loss $17.6 million in Q3, and loss $162.6 million vs profit $7.5 million in nine months.
After charges, Q3 net loss was $19.8 million vs profit $83.5 million, and for nine months profit $89.0 million vs loss $134.3 million.
Year-ago nine months oper net includes equity in losses of Dow Corning Corp of $348 million.
Sales represent sales from continuing operations. Net sales were $919.2 million vs $1.05 billion in Q3, and $2.66 billion vs $2.44 billion in nine months.
First Call mean estimate for 1996 Q3 was $0.41 per share.
